workload: tracemalloc peak while constructing a 620-accessory whole-home bridge; every characteristic is created by Loader.get_char.
notes: get_char copies the catalog dict for every characteristic. On this bridge that copy is 1243608 bytes at loader.py:47, and the traced peak of the build is 3746899 bytes. A copy-on-write properties object from get_char can remove that copy (over 1 MiB) while keeping per-instance override_properties and the same accessory metadata (sorted JSON sha256 7684060f53461e87d5a6c84ac2df8e3cad393b70a92845495669e7eefbd84cce). Overlap: in the last 30 days loader.py was only touched by typing/format PRs #506, #526 and #528; no open PR touches it; dexhunter has no loader PR. This is not Characteristic.to_HAP (#530).
